_comment: Defects that predate the epic-under-epic rule becoming reachable (`itka`, issue #941). The rule existed and could not be taken, so the corpus was never judged against it; making it reachable surfaces what was always there. Re-parenting somebody's epic is a judgement about that epic's content and belongs to its owner, so the checker's author records it rather than repairs it. THIS FILE MAY ONLY SHRINK: an entry nothing matches is reported stale and fails, so a repair cannot leave a licence behind.
_shape: Same as bean-bodies-baseline.json. Key is `<rule>:<bean-id>` — stable across a title edit, because a title is prose and an id is not.
